text:
lina: Heads-up: dependency advisory from OSS scanner: libfasttext v0.9.1 has a heap OOB in the text parsing code that can be triggered by crafted binary model files. Embedding-worker uses libfasttext for legacy embed ops. Potential for remote crash and memory disclosure. Initial risk level: medium-high.

security-alert-bot: vuln detected: libfasttext v0.9.1; cve_reference=pending; affected_service=embedding-worker; fingerprint=lf-0.9.1-parse

omar: Thanks L. Can you confirm which runtimes bundle libfasttext? I think only embedding-worker:v2 and the offline-embed-service. Not in runtime inference nodes.

lina: Confirmed: embedding-worker:v2 (k8s ns embed-prod), offline-embed-service (batch), and a few internal dev images in staging.

jess: Quick mitigation options: 1) disable legacy fasttext-based embed endpoints (we can route to fallback transformer embedder) 2) build patched libfasttext (upstream patch exists in PR) and roll new images 3) block uploads of .ftz model files until patch.

henry: If we disable endpoints, what perf cost? Transformer fallback is ~2x CPU and increased latency but low risk. We should throttle rather than full disable if we can.

lina: Initial plan (short): 1) block .ftz uploads at API gateway 2) enable transformer fallback for new requests 3) build/push patched images with libfasttext v0.9.1+patch -> embed:v2.0.1-hotfix 4) canary + rollout.

deploy-bot: Building embed image: embed:v2.0.1-hotfix started. CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/pipe/6421

jess: Block rule (gateway):
```
# deny upload of .ftz model artifacts at api gateway
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATE_ADMIN" \\
  https://gateway.internal.redwood/api/rules \\
  -d '{"match":{"path":"/v1/models/upload","file_ext":".ftz"},"action":"deny","reason":"security:fasttext"}'
```

security-alert-bot: gateway rule applied by jess at 1744002065, rule_id=gw-sec-872

henry: I kicked off a canary deploy for embed:v2.0.1-hotfix to 2/10 hosts in embed-prod. Monitoring crashloop metrics and mem lifetime.

deploy-bot: Canary: embed:v2.0.1-hotfix -> hosts 2/10. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/6421/logs

qa-bot: Running regression tests against patched image. Tests: embed-parse-fuzz, integration-embed, perf-smoke. ETA 18m.

lina: Also let's rotate the service token used by batch-upload to the offline-embed-service (it had wide write rights to model-store). I'll open a short-lived key for the service and revoke the old.

jess: Good call. Also adding a read-only policy for model-store for embed-worker; no direct write required. Policy change PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/iam/pull/88

omar: Support: please prepare a canned notification for customers who uploaded custom fasttext models in last 90 days. We'll only notify if we identify affected models or if we have to deny retrievals.

support: On it. Will ping #customer-success for review and include suggested remediation steps for customers.

henry: Canary looks healthy at 12m. No crashes observed, mem profiles normal. Requesting staged rollout to 50% then 100% after QA green.

qa-bot: Regression pass: embed-parse-fuzz found two edge cases fixed by patch. Integration tests: pass. Perf-smoke: transformer fallback baseline vs patch shows negligible change for fasttext code paths.

lina: Proceed with 50% rollout. We'll keep gateway block until we confirm no lingering vulnerable code in any image.

deploy-bot: Rolling: 50% -> 100% pending QA signoff.

jess: Post-deploy followups: 1) run a scan for .ftz model files in model-store and tag them for manual review: `python tools/model_audit.py --ext .ftz --tag fasttext-review` 2) add a CI check to fail image builds containing libfasttext <=0.9.1.

lina: Good. Also putting a short-lived incident ticket SEC-472; owner=@lina; deadline: initial triage doc in 48h.

security-alert-bot: incident logged: SEC-472; severity=medium-high; detected_at=1744002000

omar: One last ask: security team to coordinate with legal if we decide to inform customers broadly. Lina please loop in legal if we go beyond direct affected notifications.

lina: Will do. Thanks everyone, nice fast turnaround. Keep alerts in this thread for timeline.

support: Customer advisory draft ready in #customer-success for review.

henry: Rollout complete 100%. No regressions in prod metrics at 30m.

lina: Closing short-term actions: gateway block, patched images rolled, service token rotated, model-store audit queued. We'll keep SEC-472 open for root cause and postmortem.
